sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha,J.
1. Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri O.P. Dwivedi, learned
Aga for the State.

2. Present writ petition has been preferred for quashing the F.I.R. dated 10.09.2024 registered as
Case Crime No. 0555 of 2024 under Sections 420, 406, 504 and 506 I.P.C. P.S. Kotwali Dehat, Distt.
Bulandshahr.
Sudhir Kumar Goyal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 May, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174967806/
1

3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated int
the present case and no offence as such has been made out and the sale deed referred to in the first
information report has not even been put to challenge

, however, admitted that the petitioner is in
jail since 16.12.2023 on account of his false implication in several cases.

4.  Per contra, learned A.G.A. on instructions pointed out that the petitioner has criminal history of 43 other cases as well apart from the present criminal prosecution and admittedly the petitioner is in jail.
It was also pointed out that most of the cases relates to offences under Sections 420, 468, 467 I.P.C. i.e. committing fraud and cheating.
In the present case also the nature of allegation is also of the same nature.
It was also pointed out that the criminal history also involves cases under Section 304A and 306 I.P.C. as well.
5. On perusal of the first information report, we find that the cognizable offence is made out.
The petitioner is habitual offender facing 43 cases.

6. Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
